## What can FAIR data do?
Geographic outlier detection - OBIS eDNA taxonomy [QC tool](https://ednaqc.obis.org/)

![](assets/figure_QCtool_top.png)

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="30%"}
dataset quality profile: 
alignment of species detections to known distribution and thermal ranges
:::


::: {.column width="70%"}
![](assets/figure_QCtool_example.png)
:::
::::

::: {.notes}
The automated tool assesses all the identified records using the species’ distribution — 
the areas where a given species is known to live based on information from OBIS and GBIF (excluding eDNA occurrences) — 
and the species’ thermal range — the range of temperatures in which a species is known to live. 
All species identifications receive a score based on these categories. 
If a species was identified from a sample outside its known living areas or if the 
temperature at the sampling site is outside the suitable range for that species, 
the identification receives an overall low score and is highlighted on the list.

:::
